summary: Conviction under IPC s.304 read with s.34 upheld; assault with darat (sickle) caused skull fracture; death due to asphyxia following gastroenteritis during treatment; FIR by deceased, medical evidence supports causation; High Court improperly reversed trial court's acquittal; prosecution proved common intention and role of appellants; conviction restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence under Section 304 IPC read with Section 34 IPC upheld; impugned order of High Court set aside.
